ingrid: FYI customer reported a spike in 401s + huge bill for last hour. They say the Go client keeps retrying and they see duplicate charges. Attaching the short log and config they gave.

alex: can you paste their SDK version + http.Client config? also any stack traces? 401s during retries sounds like a token refresh race or retry-after misread. :thinking:

ingrid: from customer: "using github.com/redwood/inference-go v0.8.0, no custom http.Client, just sdk.NewClient(apiKey) with default settings. Calls are in a goroutine per request, ctx with 15s deadline, we cancel ctx on shutdown. Logs: 401 for X requests, then 200, then repeated 401s. They saw ~3 retries per request and token rotated in the middle.

alex: that aligns with a known issue in v0.8.0 where the retry logic doesn't short-circuit on 401 when we detect auth refresh in parallel. Two likely contributors: 1) default http.Transport reuses connections/keepalive so a request that had old auth header can be retried on same connection; 2) client cancels context incorrectly causing partial requests to be retried while token refresh happens.

maya: repro steps I usually give: minimal program to reproduce auth race (run in loop):

```
ctx := context.Background()
cli := inference.NewClient("$REDWOOD_KEY") // v0.8.0 default
for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
    go func() {
        ctx2, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
        defer cancel()
        _, err := cli.Generate(ctx2, &inference.Request{Prompt: "ping"})
        log.Println("resp err:", err)
    }()
}
select {}
```

Then trigger an auth rotation on the server side (short-lived key) or flip the key from the portal to simulate token change; you'll often see a burst of 401s and retries.

ryan: short-term mitigations: set SDK retry max to 2, and disable retry on 401s:

```
cli := inference.NewClient(apiKey, inference.WithRetryMax(2), inference.WithRetryPredicate(func(code int) bool {
    // don't retry 401
    return code != 401 && code >= 500
}))
```

Also, add a custom http.Client so you control keepalives/timeouts:

```
tr := &http.Transport{
    DisableKeepAlives:   true,
    MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 2,
    IdleConnTimeout:     30 * time.Second,
}
hc := &http.Client{Transport: tr, Timeout: 15 * time.Second}
cli := inference.NewClient(apiKey, inference.WithHTTPClient(hc))
```

alex: long-term fix: upgrade to v0.9.2 (we shipped a backoff + dedupe fix). It avoids retrying requests that are currently being auth-refreshed and includes better jitter. If customer can't upgrade immediately, the http.Transport tweak plus disabling retries on 401 is the safest path.

ingrid: customer says they run on k8s autoscaler and cancelling ctxs on pod termination may have been racing with inflight requests. Any guidance for proper shutdown?

maya: ensure you call client.CloseIdleConnections() before stopping and don't cancel parent ctx until in-flight work completes. Example shutdown:

```
// graceful shutdown handler
shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
// stop accepting new work
wg.Wait() // wait for inflight goroutines to finish
client.CloseIdleConnections()
cancel()
```

Also ensure you attach ctx to each request: `req = req.WithContext(ctx)` (our SDK does this normally if you pass ctx into Generate).

support-bot: Reminder: billing investigations require customer request IDs and timestamps. Ask for one example request_time + trace id.

ingrid: done — asked customer for one example trace id + timing window. I also gave them the short-term config snippet and suggested upgrade path.

alex: For internal follow-up: create a short KB for support with the above mitigations and code snippets. This is a recurring pattern — mark as "auth-retry-race" and include version gating (<= v0.8.1).

maya: I'll draft the KB and include the reproducible snippet, plus a note to recommend `WithRetryPredicate` to block 401 retries. :thumbsup:

ryan: if customer provides trace id and we confirm duplicate billable requests caused by retry loops we'll issue credit and recommend the config change.

ingrid: closing loop — customer will try the DisableKeepAlives + RetryPredicate change, report back. I'll escalate to eng if they still see problems after upgrade. Thanks all.
